interview.title: Design DNA Interview
interview.description: Let Occipitum understand your visual identity through a brief conversation.
interview.welcomeQuestion: Let's begin. Close your eyes for a moment — if your brand were a place, what would it feel like to walk through it?
interview.q2: When someone visits your site for the first time, what emotion should linger after they leave?
interview.q3: Imagine your ideal client's desk. What objects are on it? What colors surround them?
interview.q4: If your services were a piece of music, what genre and tempo would they be?
interview.q5: Think of a website you secretly admire — not a competitor, something unexpected. What draws you to it?
interview.q6: What visual cliché in your industry makes you cringe the most?
interview.q7: Your brand has a rhythm — is it the sharp staccato of a typewriter or the flowing curves of handwritten script?
interview.q8: Name three words that should never appear on your website. Why?
interview.analyzing: Thank you. I'm now weaving your answers into a design DNA profile...
interview.complete: Your design DNA has been captured. Occipitum can now generate canvas proposals that resonate with your identity.
interview.error: Something went wrong during the analysis. Please try again.

occipitum.description: Generate an innovative canvas proposal powered by your design DNA. Each generation uses a unique creativity seed for fresh, non-stereotypical results.
occipitum.proposalAppliedDescription: A new Occipitum design proposal was loaded into your canvas.
